sentences.en: That folk singer is very popular with people in general.
sentences.zh: 那位民谣歌手很受大众欢迎。

sentences.en: She can play all kinds of instruments, classical or folk.
sentences.zh: 她能演奏各种乐器，无论是古典还是民间音乐。

sentences.en: Most folks ate very quickly and the food soon disappeared.
sentences.zh: 大多数人吃得很快，食物很快就吃完了。
